_note: Every text source needs an entry. status 'approved' = license read and accepted by the owner; anything else is refused by gpu/sources.py. Not legal advice: verify each license before commercial use.

ar-wikipedia.notes: Attribution and share-alike apply; keep this entry as the attribution record.

en-wikipedia.notes: Same terms as Arabic Wikipedia; used for at most 25% of the Arabic volume.

sadah-kb.notes: Built from Wikipedia/Wikidata by SADAH's own agents; inherits their licenses.

sadah-corpus.notes: Texts the owner wrote or has the right to use.

arabic-web-crawl.notes: Large open Arabic web crawls (e.g. OSCAR, CulturaX): read the dataset card and each terms of use, then set approved.

gulf-dialogues.notes: Real conversations only with the speakers' written consent and personal data removed.
